title: MZ Removing HP and MP bars and Keyboard info window on VisuStella Core MZ

posts.author: blanketorghost
posts.body:
Hi!!
I'm currently working on a solo horror rpg maker game a-la yume nikki/mad father, but I have found some issues with customizing certain scenes with the VisuStella Core MZ plugins.
Firstly, in the name window, the padding between lines in the upper window is oddly wrong (I am currently using a custom font for dialogue, but will later change to another font for UI with Galv's custom font loader plugin)
don't mind the background just yet, I have plans to customize it later once I have the layout figured out;;
I'd also like to get rid of the window that instead is used for the 'Keyboard Message' setting (can edit the message in Keyboard Input > Name Input > Keyboard message) or if it's even possible in the first place.
Second, I'd like to remove the HP and MP bars that are displayed in the main menu (I am using Solo layout and using sprite as a placeholder) also hopefully the money tab?
I have tried editing the main .js file and comment out all gold and gauge related lines, but now I'm finding it conflicts with the VizuStella plugins
Is there any way to edit the VisuMZ plugin alone to remove those? or do I need to also edit the main rmmz_windows.js file as well?
